mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 20-day forward window, the S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a Federal Reserve tightening cycle, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening consumer demand environment that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST decline and UNRATE rise) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.5%), a decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals an impending slowdown in economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.5%, a decline in PAYEMS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal in the regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases fail to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,500,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1500.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates stagflationary pressures that trigger a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL rise and GDPC1 decline) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high interest rates (FEDFUNDS above 5.0%), a decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary trend that reduces the risk of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, a decline in CPIAUCSL fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal in the regime is below 0.03.
